current_patterns: Narration is a post-resolution render layer; committed runtime state remains owned by SceneRuntime and SessionMapState.
NarrativeState patches already centralize allowed public paths and authoritative-path rejection in patches.py.
VectorContextStore is a small Protocol consumed by NarrationPipeline, allowing persistent and in-memory stores to share retrieval/write boundaries.
Tests under tests/scene build real SceneRuntime sessions and assert narration does not mutate runtime snapshots.
tech_debt: Candidate PersistentNarrationMemoryStore lacks default session/module isolation and patch-level provenance preservation.
Candidate graph_memory.py scopes entities by path only, so cross-session facts can supersede each other.
Candidate graph store is manually ingested and lacks pipeline integration, close lifecycle, and defensive path validation.
Formal MCP run initially recorded candidate implementation before tree-rubric artifacts and must be corrected with validated artifacts.

architecture.decision_rationale: The narration package already has clean seams for memory retrieval, record writing, patch validation, and post-resolution pipeline rendering. Incremental hardening satisfies the requested persistence/audit/search/invalidation and graph skeleton without changing authoritative runtime ownership.

proposed_changes.description: Record revised plan, architecture, dispatch, per-group tree rubrics, execution, validation, QA, and final assessment artifacts through the MCP server.
Keep VectorMemoryMetadata lifecycle/scope/provenance fields as the contract surface for persistent memory and graph citations.
Add scoped retrieval/search, explicit global seed handling, patch tags/provenance, stale supersession, redaction, tolerant JSONL load audit, and local locking around persistence.
Cover reload, cross-session/module isolation, global seed retrieval, per-patch event ids, path supersession, redaction, invalid JSONL recovery, search, forget, and audit.

Scope graph entities/facts by session/module, reject non-narrative paths via existing patch rules, expose as-of-turn queries, add schema metadata/FKs/indexes, and provide close/context-manager lifecycle.
Cover scoped graph supersession, cross-session isolation, authoritative-path rejection, temporal as-of query, source-event provenance, audit, and lifecycle close.
Accept an optional graph store and ingest accepted records after repository and vector memory writes without making graph facts authoritative.
Keep public exports aligned with PersistentNarrationMemoryStore and SQLiteNarrationGraphMemory surfaces used by tests and downstream callers.
Assert pipeline graph ingestion occurs and committed SessionMapState remains unchanged after rendering.
Update the user-facing implementation plan to point at the formal MCP redo run and remaining validation evidence.
Document the ADR for non-authoritative narration memory, scope isolation, auditability, invalidation, and graph integration.
